neighbours.label: single-letter onset piece ' h' / ' H' / ' N' that begins a word split into several tokens (h+opped, H+anoi, N+amp+ula)
fire: The brewers said the new ale is heavily hopped with citrus varieties.
This lager is lightly hopped, so it tastes smooth and a little sweet.
A small frog hopped onto the lily pad and sat very still.
Our flight from Bangkok landed in Hanoi just after midnight.
The old quarter of Hanoi is full of narrow streets and street food.
Aid trucks reached the province of Nampula after the cyclone.
Fishermen on the shores of Lake Nyanza sell their catch at dawn.
From the airport in Hilo we drove up toward the volcano.

notes: Probe: ' h' in 'heavily hopped' 0.81, 'rabbit hopped' 0.36, ' H' in Hanoi 0.42, ' N' in Nampula 0.24, Hikaru 0.21, HDFS 0.11, Hmong only 0.04; whole-token Hamburg/Helsinki 0.002.
